entries.proposition: Eight male cynomolgus macaques only: six by lumbar intrathecal catheter (LIT-KT), two by intracerebroventricular (ICV) injection; animals with neutralising titres of 1/50 or more were not used.
entries.snippet: We selected primates that had no detectable or low titers (<1/50) of neutralizing factors against AAV serotypes 9 and 10 in the serum.

entries.proposition: Capsid and cargo: self-complementary AAV9 or AAVrh10 carrying GFP under a CBA-miR142-target promoter, CsCl-purified.
entries.snippet: The AAV2 plasmids contain the gene encoding the GFP under the control of a ubiquitous hybrid of the CBA and 4 repeated sequences of miR142.

entries.proposition: ICV dose: 4.5E+12 vg per animal in 0.5 mL; euthanasia three weeks after dosing.
entries.snippet: leading to a dose of 4.5E+12 vg for each AAV9-CBA-GFP ICV-injected NHP (Table 1). 3 weeks after dosing, the animals were euthanized
entries.anchor: Results, AAV9 achieved strong MNs and consistent brain transduction, para 4

entries.proposition: LIT-KT dose was 2.5E+13 vg per animal, which the authors call an inferior dose compared with an earlier study.
entries.snippet: An inferior dose (2.5E+13 vg per NHP) was injected by LIT-KT administration in the present study.

entries.proposition: Immunosuppression: sirolimus, prednisolone and mycophenolate mofetil, daily; the Methods give no start day relative to dosing in the sentence.
entries.snippet: The injected animals were immunosuppressed with sirolimus 2 mg/kg/day (Rapamune), prednisolone 1 to 2 mg/kg/day (Dermipred), and mycophenolate mofetil 40 mg/kg/day (CellCept)
entries.anchor: Materials and Methods, In Vivo AAV Injections

entries.proposition: DRG transduction: GFP in the soma of large-diameter neurons and in fibres, mostly cervical and lumbar after LIT-KT and thoracic and lumbar after ICV.
entries.snippet: We found robust GFP expression in the soma of large-diameter neurons, mainly, and in fibers within all transduced DRG
entries.anchor: Results, AAVrh10 serotype and DRG, para 1

entries.proposition: Substance P staining showed no co-localisation with GFP in cervical and lumbar DRG for either capsid.
entries.snippet: SP immunostaining did not reveal any colocalization with GFP in the cervical and lumbar DRG for either AAV serotype

entries.proposition: DRG histopathology: multifocal mild mononuclear infiltration in thoracic and lumbar DRG of two AAVrh10 animals.
entries.snippet: Subsequent histopathological examination revealed multifocal mild mononuclear cell infiltration in thoracic and lumbar DRG for LIT-KT AAVrh10-injected Mac 1 and Mac 2 animals, respectively (Figure S5).

entries.proposition: DRG histopathology: moderate infiltration in cervical and lumbar DRG of one AAV9 animal.
entries.snippet: Moderate mononuclear cell infiltration was observed in cervical and lumbar DRG for Mac 3 animals (Figure S5).

entries.proposition: DRG fibres of three AAV9 animals showed infiltration and myelin digestion chambers.
entries.snippet: we also found mononuclear cell infiltration and digestion chambers that lead to myelin degradation (Figure S5)

entries.proposition: The brain histopathology reported no lesions.
entries.snippet: Histopathological examination of the brain did not reveal any lesions.

entries.proposition: Figure S5 legend: representative lesions only (no scoring).
entries.snippet: Haematoxylin, eosine and saffron staining were performed in cervical, thoracic and lumbar DRGs of all NHPs
